# Teachy

> > Teachy is an AI-powered platform that helps teachers create lesson plans, educational slides, worksheets, and classroom materials with automated tools for grading and content generation.

The platform serves educators worldwide with AI teaching assistants that support lesson planning, worksheet generation, and classroom activities. Teachy provides ready-made educational materials covering subjects like mathematics, measurement, and number systems, with support for diverse learning needs including Brazilian Sign Language accessibility.

## Key Topics

- AI Teaching Assistant
- Lesson Planning
- Educational Materials
- Worksheet Generation
- Automated Grading
- Teacher Tools
- Classroom Activities
- Mathematics Education
- Elementary Math
- Number Systems
- Place Value
- Measurement Tools
- Educational Slides
- Brazilian Sign Language
- MS Word Integration

## Platform Overview

- [Teachy - Artificial Intelligence for Teachers - Lesson Plans and More!](https://teachy.ai/): Main platform homepage for educators to access AI-powered teaching tools, lesson plan generators, and educational material creation features

## Mathematics Educational Slides

- [Slide: Number System Basics](https://teachy.ai/en/slides/number-system-basics): Comprehensive slides covering number systems, place value concepts, and digit representation for elementary mathematics instruction
- [Slide: Measurement: Tools and Units](https://teachy.ai/en/slides/measurement-tools-and-units): Teaching presentation materials on measurement tools, metric unit systems, and practical measurement applications
